lines.text: God tells Jacob to go to Bethel, so Jacob buries his household's foreign gods and earrings under the oak near Shechem.
Jacob arrives in Luz, builds an altar, and calls the place El-bethel because God revealed Himself to him there.
God blesses Jacob again, renames him Israel, and promises that prophets will descend from him and that he will have the land.
Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin on the way to Ephrath, and Jacob sets up a pillar on her grave.
Jacob returns to his father Isaac at Mamre, and after Isaac dies at 120 years, Esau and Jacob bury him.
